bugs.title: "All mail" does nothing when clicked
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
stepsToReproduce: 4. Observe that nothing on the page changes.
bugs.expectedResult: Clicking the tab navigates, opens something, or changes what is on screen.
bugs.actualResult: After the click the URL is unchanged, no dialog opened, and the page content is byte-identical — the control has no visible effect.

bugs.title: 1 form control(s) have no accessible label on Locations > Inbox
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
stepsToReproduce: 3. Inspect the form controls listed above and confirm none carries a label association.
bugs.expectedResult: Every form control is named by a <label for>, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so assistive technology can announce it.
bugs.actualResult: 1 control(s) are named only by placeholder text or by nothing at all: button[type=button] (Filter by label)

bugs.title: Field "Current page number" silently truncates input
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
stepsToReproduce: 3. Type 300 characters into the "Current page number" field.
4. Observe that only 1 characters are kept and nothing explains why.
bugs.expectedResult: A field that limits length declares it (maxlength, a counter, or a validation message) so the user knows the value was cut.
bugs.actualResult: 300 characters were entered and the field kept 1, with no maxlength attribute and no message.

bugs.title: 3 control(s) have no accessible name on Locations > Inbox
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
bugs.expectedResult: Every button, link and tab has text or an aria-label, so it can be announced and reached by voice.
bugs.actualResult: 3 control(s) announce as nothing. First: div > div:nth-of-type(1) > div > button:nth-of-type(1)
